title: United's Orphaned Seats, Ryanair Clips a Wingtip in Dublin, and the Sonic Boom Ban Might Be Ending
summary: United has hundreds of business class seats sitting in storage for a plane it still can't fly, and the story is somehow both hilarious and expensive. Plus, a Ryanair 737 MAX scrapes a wingtip aborting a landing in Dublin crosswinds, the FAA quietly moves to end the 53-year ban on supersonic flight over the US, and Nashville's airport might soon be named after Dolly Parton.
